a natural enemy, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} the ruler of an adjacent country;
 see <ls>Malli.</ls> on <ls>Śi. 2. 36</ls>.

a natural neutral {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} a ruler whose dominions
 lie beyond those of the natural ally.

a natural ally; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} a ruler whose dominions lie
